easy: Only just enough, with nothing extra.

ex.en: We had only the bare minimum of food for the trip.
ex.ko: 우리는 여행에 최소한의 음식만 가지고 있었다.

easy: Not covered by anything.

ex.en: The puppy slept on the bare floor.
ex.ko: 강아지는 아무것도 깔리지 않은 바닥에서 잤다.

easy: The room under a house, below the ground. People keep old things there.

ex.en: We keep our bikes in the basement.
ex.ko: 우리는 자전거를 지하실에 보관한다.

easy: An unfair opinion about someone or something before you know the facts.

ex.en: The referee showed bias toward the home team.
ex.ko: 심판은 홈팀에 편견을 보였다.

easy: To change what someone thinks in an unfair way.

ex.en: Don't bias your friend by telling her your answer first.
ex.ko: 친구에게 네 답을 먼저 말해서 편견을 갖게 하지 마.

easy: To say that something you planned will not happen.

ex.en: The school canceled the picnic because of rain.
ex.ko: 학교는 비 때문에 소풍을 취소했다.

easy: To make something weaker by having something that balances it.

ex.en: The cool breeze canceled out the heat a little.
ex.ko: 시원한 바람이 더위를 조금 상쇄했다.

easy: To say officially that something does not count anymore.

ex.en: The teacher canceled my friend's score because he cheated.
ex.ko: 선생님은 친구가 부정행위를 해서 그의 점수를 무효로 했다.

easy: To cover a whole place, like a soft rug.

ex.en: Red leaves carpeted the ground in the park.
ex.ko: 단풍잎이 공원 땅을 뒤덮었다.

easy: To put a soft rug over a whole floor.

ex.en: Dad carpeted my bedroom floor last week.
ex.ko: 아빠는 지난주에 내 방 바닥에 카펫을 깔아 주셨다.

easy: The flat part at the top of a room, above your head.

ex.en: A spider was hanging from the ceiling.
ex.ko: 거미 한 마리가 천장에 매달려 있었다.

easy: The highest amount that is allowed.

ex.en: Mom put a ceiling of ten dollars on party gifts.
ex.ko: 엄마는 파티 선물에 10달러라는 상한을 정하셨다.

easy: A tree that grows small round red fruit in summer.

ex.en: A cherry tree grows in our yard.
ex.ko: 우리 마당에는 체리나무가 자란다.

easy: A small, round, sweet red fruit with one hard seed inside.

ex.en: I put a cherry on top of my ice cream.
ex.ko: 나는 아이스크림 위에 체리를 올렸다.

easy: A cold feeling in the air.

ex.en: There was a chill in the morning air.
ex.ko: 아침 공기에 냉기가 돌았다.

easy: A quick scary feeling that makes your body shake a little.

ex.en: A chill ran down my back during the scary story.
ex.ko: 무서운 이야기를 듣는 동안 등줄기에 오싹함이 흘렀다.

easy: A cold, shaky feeling you get when you are getting sick.

ex.en: I had a chill and a fever, so I stayed home.
ex.ko: 나는 오한과 열이 나서 집에 있었다.

easy: Gathering things and putting them together.

ex.en: Collecting stickers is my favorite hobby.
ex.ko: 스티커 모으기는 내가 가장 좋아하는 취미다.

easy: Done on purpose, after thinking about it.

ex.en: I made a conscious effort to be kind to my little brother.
ex.ko: 나는 동생에게 친절하려고 의식적으로 노력했다.

easy: Awake and able to know what is happening around you.

ex.en: The player stayed conscious after he fell.
ex.ko: 그 선수는 넘어진 뒤에도 의식이 있었다.

easy: Knowing about something and noticing it.

ex.en: I was conscious of everyone watching me sing.
ex.ko: 나는 모두가 내 노래를 보고 있다는 것을 알고 있었다.

easy: Coming one right after another.

ex.en: Our team won three consecutive games.
ex.ko: 우리 팀은 세 경기를 연속으로 이겼다.

easy: The things that are inside something.

ex.en: I dumped the contents of my backpack on the bed.
ex.ko: 나는 책가방 속 내용물을 침대 위에 쏟았다.

easy: A list at the front of a book that shows where each part starts.

ex.en: Look at the table of contents to find chapter three.
ex.ko: 목차를 보고 3장을 찾아봐.

easy: Going on for so long that it gets boring.

ex.en: The car ride felt endless.
ex.ko: 차를 타고 가는 시간이 끝이 없는 것처럼 느껴졌다.

easy: So many that you cannot count them.

ex.en: There were endless stars in the desert sky.
ex.ko: 사막 하늘에는 무수한 별이 있었다.

easy: Got away from a place where it was kept.

ex.en: The escaped hamster was hiding behind the couch.
ex.ko: 도망친 햄스터는 소파 뒤에 숨어 있었다.

easy: Resting on top of water instead of sinking.

ex.en: A floating leaf drifted down the stream.
ex.ko: 물 위에 떠 있는 나뭇잎이 개울을 따라 흘러갔다.

easy: Food that is thrown away.

ex.en: The garbage from lunch smelled bad by the end of the week.
ex.ko: 점심 음식물 쓰레기에서 주말 무렵에는 냄새가 났다.

easy: A big can or bin where you throw away trash.

ex.en: She threw the old banana peel into the garbage.
ex.ko: 그녀는 오래된 바나나 껍질을 쓰레기통에 던졌다.

easy: One tiny piece of something, like sand or salt.

ex.en: A grain of sand got in my shoe.
ex.ko: 모래 한 알갱이가 내 신발에 들어갔다.

easy: Seeds of plants like wheat and rice that people eat.

ex.en: Farmers grow grain like wheat and rice.
ex.ko: 농부들은 밀과 쌀 같은 곡물을 기른다.

easy: The machine that keeps a building warm.

ex.en: The heating in our school broke, so we wore coats.
ex.ko: 학교 난방이 고장 나서 우리는 외투를 입었다.

easy: Figuring out who or what something is.

ex.en: The identification of the bird took a long time.
ex.ko: 그 새를 확인하는 데는 오랜 시간이 걸렸다.

easy: A card or paper that shows who you are.

ex.en: Dad showed his identification at the airport.
ex.ko: 아빠는 공항에서 신분증을 보여 주셨다.

easy: The flat top part of your legs when you sit down.

ex.en: The cat curled up in my lap.
ex.ko: 고양이가 내 무릎 위에 웅크리고 앉았다.

easy: A train that runs under the ground in a big city.

ex.en: We took the metro to the museum.
ex.ko: 우리는 지하철을 타고 박물관에 갔다.

easy: Having to do with a very big city.

ex.en: Seoul is a huge metropolitan city with millions of people.
ex.ko: 서울은 수백만 명이 사는 거대한 대도시다.

easy: Having to do with the group of people who make a country's laws.

ex.en: My uncle watched the parliamentary debate on TV.
ex.ko: 삼촌은 텔레비전으로 의회 토론을 보셨다.

easy: A way of thinking about something.

ex.en: My perception of math changed after I learned some tricks.
ex.ko: 요령을 배우고 나서 수학에 대한 내 인식이 바뀌었다.

easy: Noticing things with your eyes, ears, nose, or other senses.

ex.en: A dog's perception of smell is much stronger than ours.
ex.ko: 개의 냄새 지각 능력은 우리보다 훨씬 강하다.

easy: To keep going forward.

ex.en: After the bell, the class proceeded to the playground.
ex.ko: 종이 울린 뒤 반 아이들은 운동장으로 나아갔다.

easy: Kept for one person, so no one else can use it.

ex.en: This seat is reserved for my grandma.
ex.ko: 이 자리는 할머니를 위해 예약되어 있다.

easy: Quiet and not showing your feelings much.

ex.en: My reserved cousin hardly says a word at big parties.
ex.ko: 내 내성적인 사촌은 큰 파티에서 거의 말을 하지 않는다.

easy: To fix something so it is like it was before.

ex.en: Workers restored the old bridge so cars could use it again.
ex.ko: 일꾼들이 낡은 다리를 복원해서 차가 다시 지나갈 수 있게 했다.

easy: To give someone new energy and make them feel strong again.

ex.en: A nap restored my energy after the long hike.
ex.ko: 낮잠을 자고 나니 긴 하이킹 뒤에 힘이 회복되었다.

easy: To give something back to the person it belongs to.

ex.en: The police restored the lost bike to its owner.
ex.ko: 경찰은 잃어버린 자전거를 주인에게 돌려주었다.

easy: To look through things quickly and messily to find something.

ex.en: My little sister rifled through the toy box looking for her doll.
ex.ko: 여동생은 인형을 찾느라 장난감 상자를 샅샅이 뒤졌다.

easy: A person who moves fast on foot in a race.

ex.en: The fastest runner in our class won the race.
ex.ko: 우리 반에서 가장 빠른 달리기 선수가 경주에서 이겼다.

easy: Used to say that something is a pity.

ex.en: Sadly, our picnic was canceled because of rain.
ex.ko: 안타깝게도 비 때문에 우리 소풍이 취소되었다.

easy: In a way that shows you feel unhappy.

ex.en: The boy sadly waved goodbye to his best friend.
ex.ko: 소년은 가장 친한 친구에게 슬프게 손을 흔들며 작별 인사를 했다.

easy: How important or meaningful something is.

ex.en: The teacher explained the significance of Independence Day.
ex.ko: 선생님은 독립기념일의 의미를 설명해 주셨다.

easy: Something you rub on your hands with water to get them clean.

ex.en: Wash your hands with soap and water.
ex.ko: 비누와 물로 손을 씻어라.

easy: Said louder or with more force than the other parts of a word.

ex.en: In the word apple, the first syllable is stressed.
ex.ko: apple이라는 단어에서는 첫 음절에 강세가 있다.

easy: Having to do with how a building is put together.

ex.en: The storm caused structural damage to the old barn.
ex.ko: 폭풍은 낡은 헛간에 구조적인 손상을 입혔다.

easy: The language that people in a country in eastern Europe speak.

ex.en: My friend speaks Ukrainian at home.
ex.ko: 내 친구는 집에서 우크라이나어를 쓴다.

easy: A person who comes from a country in eastern Europe.

ex.en: Our new neighbor is a Ukrainian who loves soccer.
ex.ko: 우리 새 이웃은 축구를 좋아하는 우크라이나 사람이다.

easy: Having to do with a country in eastern Europe and its people.

ex.en: We ate Ukrainian soup called borscht at the festival.
ex.ko: 우리는 축제에서 보르시치라는 우크라이나 수프를 먹었다.

easy: Not needed.

ex.en: Wearing a coat on a hot day is unnecessary.
ex.ko: 더운 날 외투를 입는 것은 불필요하다.

easy: Changed so it works better in a certain place or for a certain job.

ex.en: Polar bears are adapted to live in the cold.
ex.ko: 북극곰은 추운 곳에서 살도록 적응해 있다.

easy: Saying yes to something and starting to use it.

ex.en: The class voted for the adoption of the new game rule.
ex.ko: 반 아이들은 새 게임 규칙을 채택하자고 투표했다.

easy: When a family takes a child to be their own, even if the child was born to other parents.

ex.en: My cousin's adoption day was a big family party.
ex.ko: 사촌의 입양 기념일은 큰 가족 파티였다.

easy: Without a name, so no one knows who it is from.

ex.en: Someone left an anonymous note on my desk.
ex.ko: 누군가 내 책상에 익명의 쪽지를 놓고 갔다.

easy: Coming closer to something.

ex.en: The approaching of the storm made the sky dark.
ex.ko: 폭풍이 다가오자 하늘이 어두워졌다.

easy: Having to do with art or people who make art.

ex.en: My sister comes from an artistic family.
ex.ko: 내 언니는 예술가 집안 출신이다.

easy: Beautiful and nice to look at.

ex.en: She made an artistic drawing of the sunset.
ex.ko: 그녀는 노을을 예술적으로 그렸다.

easy: How often a student comes to school.

ex.en: Perfect attendance means you never miss a day of school.
ex.ko: 완벽한 출석이란 학교를 하루도 빠지지 않는 것이다.

easy: The number of people who come to an event.

ex.en: Attendance at the soccer game was huge.
ex.ko: 축구 경기의 참석자 수가 엄청났다.

easy: Flying planes to carry people and things.

ex.en: Aviation lets people fly across oceans in hours.
ex.ko: 항공 덕분에 사람들은 몇 시간 만에 바다를 건널 수 있다.

easy: A big round container with flat ends, used to hold liquid.

ex.en: The pirates rolled a barrel of water onto the ship.
ex.ko: 해적들은 물이 든 통을 배 위로 굴려 올렸다.

easy: To ask for good things to happen to someone.

ex.en: The grandfather blessed his grandson before the trip.
ex.ko: 할아버지는 여행 전에 손자를 축복해 주셨다.

easy: To give someone good luck and happiness.

ex.en: We are blessed with good friends and a warm home.
ex.ko: 우리는 좋은 친구들과 따뜻한 집이라는 복을 받았다.

easy: A sport where two people wear big gloves and punch each other.

ex.en: My uncle goes to a boxing gym every week.
ex.ko: 삼촌은 매주 복싱 체육관에 가신다.

easy: Putting things into a container to store or send them.

ex.en: Boxing up the toys took all afternoon.
ex.ko: 장난감을 상자에 담는 데 오후 내내 걸렸다.

easy: To throw something without much care.

ex.en: Chuck the ball to me!
ex.ko: 그 공 나한테 던져!

easy: To get rid of something by throwing it away.

ex.en: Chuck those old papers in the trash.
ex.ko: 그 낡은 종이들은 쓰레기통에 버려.

easy: A building where people go to watch movies on a big screen.

ex.en: We watched a movie at the cinema on Saturday.
ex.ko: 우리는 토요일에 영화관에서 영화를 봤다.

easy: Following the rules.

ex.en: Compliance with school rules keeps everyone safe.
ex.ko: 학교 규칙을 지키면 모두가 안전하다.

easy: Totally different from or against something else.

ex.en: His actions were contrary to what he promised.
ex.ko: 그의 행동은 약속한 것과 반대였다.

easy: Not wanting to do what other people tell you.

ex.en: My contrary little brother says no to everything.
ex.ko: 고집 센 내 남동생은 뭐든 싫다고 한다.

easy: A soft seat for two or three people to sit on.

ex.en: Our cat sleeps on the couch all day.
ex.ko: 우리 고양이는 하루 종일 소파에서 잔다.

easy: To treat people in a harsh, unfair way so they cannot speak or act freely.

ex.en: The cruel king crushed the people who disagreed with him.
ex.ko: 잔인한 왕은 자기 말에 반대하는 사람들을 억압했다.

easy: To press something hard so it breaks or goes flat.

ex.en: I crushed the empty can with my foot.
ex.ko: 나는 빈 깡통을 발로 찌그러뜨렸다.

easy: A change to a smaller number or amount.

ex.en: There was a decrease in the number of rainy days.
ex.ko: 비 오는 날의 수가 줄었다.

easy: Beaten and not the winner.

ex.en: The defeated team shook hands with the winners.
ex.ko: 패배한 팀은 우승팀과 악수했다.

easy: A sickness where the body has trouble handling sugar in the blood.

ex.en: My grandpa has diabetes, so he checks his blood sugar.
ex.ko: 할아버지는 당뇨병이 있어서 혈당을 재신다.

easy: A tasty sauce you pour on a salad.

ex.en: I like ranch dressing on my salad.
ex.ko: 나는 샐러드에 랜치 드레싱을 뿌려 먹는 게 좋다.

easy: Not strong or harsh.

ex.en: Mom gave me a gentle reminder to clean my room.
ex.ko: 엄마는 내 방을 치우라고 부드럽게 일러 주셨다.

easy: Kind and caring.

ex.en: The gentle nurse held my hand.
ex.ko: 상냥한 간호사 선생님이 내 손을 잡아 주셨다.

easy: Soft and calm to hear.

ex.en: Dad sang a lullaby in a gentle voice.
ex.ko: 아빠는 부드러운 목소리로 자장가를 불러 주셨다.

easy: The rules for how words go together in sentences.

ex.en: Our teacher checks our grammar in every essay.
ex.ko: 선생님은 우리 글마다 문법을 확인하신다.

easy: To fill a place so full that there is no room left.

ex.en: Kids jammed the bus after school.
ex.ko: 방과 후 아이들이 버스를 꽉 채웠다.

easy: To push something down hard.

ex.en: Dad jammed the brake pedal when a ball rolled into the street.
ex.ko: 공이 도로로 굴러가자 아빠가 브레이크를 꽉 밟으셨다.

easy: To hurt a part of your body by pressing or hitting it hard.

ex.en: I jammed my finger in the door.
ex.ko: 나는 문에 손가락을 찧었다.

easy: To let someone use your home or room if they pay you money.

ex.en: Grandma leases her extra room to a college student.
ex.ko: 할머니는 남는 방을 대학생에게 세 놓으셨다.

easy: Allowed by law or an official group.

ex.en: Only a licensed driver can drive a school bus.
ex.ko: 면허가 있는 운전사만 스쿨버스를 운전할 수 있다.

easy: Staying true to your friends, family, or country.

ex.en: My dog shows loyalty by waiting at the door every day.
ex.ko: 우리 개는 매일 문 앞에서 기다리며 충성심을 보여 준다.

easy: Able to pull iron things toward it, like a magnet.

ex.en: A magnetic toy sticks to the fridge.
ex.ko: 자석 장난감이 냉장고에 붙는다.

easy: Only one piece of the whole.

ex.en: We saw a partial eclipse of the sun.
ex.ko: 우리는 일부만 가려진 일식을 보았다.

easy: To make up your mind to do something.

ex.en: I resolved to practice piano every day.
ex.ko: 나는 매일 피아노를 연습하기로 결심했다.

easy: Very new and very different from what came before.

ex.en: The smartphone was a revolutionary invention.
ex.ko: 스마트폰은 혁신적인 발명품이었다.

easy: Having to do with a time when people change their government.

ex.en: We learned about the revolutionary war in history class.
ex.ko: 우리는 역사 시간에 혁명 전쟁에 대해 배웠다.

easy: To give off light and be bright.

ex.en: The sun shone brightly on the beach.
ex.ko: 해가 해변 위에서 밝게 빛났다.

easy: To look bright and shiny, like something wet.

ex.en: The floor shone after Dad mopped it.
ex.ko: 아빠가 바닥을 닦고 나니 바닥이 반짝였다.

easy: At exactly the same time.

ex.en: The twins sneezed simultaneously.
ex.ko: 쌍둥이는 동시에 재채기를 했다.

easy: Watching people or places carefully to stop trouble.

ex.en: Cameras keep the store under surveillance.
ex.ko: 카메라가 가게를 감시한다.
